content: 13:1-5 Munon oau me igesereminer eng mom-mom umiba

Qen end Galili munon qei Qenut wai waramb mian yab big igamari Rom gab man baraitari Pailat wonou yogorau munon nob yarab igaramb qeru ba mian yab big igour eng nob yesiriamirei. Pailat ende aba gab munon qei der Yisas nob qamamirei.
Ende qamarari igub Yisas taui wurinob qamar: “Aninou misir maigas, munon igaramir eng wurinou qomon boru ebet munon qei wuritanamimour end igaramirei qiyo?
Ende ue. Ye aninob qemerine igar: An aninou qomon boru mogirt wab me wogunon eng an gor ende ansiari umuboumon.

Ende ne an mai misir igoumon? Qoan ginam Siloam end munai degen aib uburab isub munon 18-ende igarama umumir eng wuri qomon boru ebet Yerusalem munon gugum wuritanami igour end umumirei qamb misir igoumon?
Eng gor ende ue. An gor aninou qomon boru me wogunon eng an gor ende umuboumon.”
13:6-9 Mit big qob: nam ger qur me bigau
Ende qamb ne mit big ete wurinob qamarei: “Munon ger nam pig gari qas wain man end uborei igo togun ombur gari uma ne qur big arit igo qamb is gar eng ue.
Ende gab ne munon man qoat igour eng nob qamar: “Qoan nam eng ubomei igama togun ombur gari uma ne see yar gaum eng ue eng gab wo ar igo mi qei irbiginer qamb song suab arirom.”
Ende qamara munon man qoat igoar eng nob qamar: “Ue, waga ar igoriner, igama togun gari e gin eng ende sig igama gab eng ye qanam qoui qubir qobot wogub mut wambin qanam qoui big gin.
Ende at togun geret gin eng qur biga gab eng sig uber, a ende sig gab eng song suab arirambam,” ende qamarei,” qamar.
13:10-17 Inorou qent Yisas yamangar ger musiarei
Inorou qen geret Yisas inorou munai end is wuriimbig igama yamangar ger ai bigau waramorei ten igama togun 18-ende warei. Ende igama git goan mom umb uburerei, me mi deges igamau.
Yisas ende gab nob qamar: “Ne musiaum, uberburiban.”
Ende qamb bea qen end qas git goan gurumot uburer eng bo git uput yar der naget mi degesi Qenut igub mismisir uber wot qamarei.

Ende aba gab munon barai aib inorou munai qoat igoar eng Yisas inorou qent yamangar eng musia uberbura gab misiringet ne munon yamangar wurinob qamar: “Misegiau qen eng 6-ende igo. An toar nob igo gab eng inmusiarar qamb eng qen wobon end gab diermar! Inorou qen e an qoyam ue igo inmusiar qamb di igoumon?”
Ende qamara Yisas taui nob qamar: “Ne qetopur quran, an qei inorou qent bur yount end isub bur qarig a dongi qamagat qamb eng wurinerub oromar isub ya wurisab igoumon.
End ne yamangar e Abraham tumbigi, end Satan mom wot isuor eng ten igama togun 18-ende wara eng gab. Igo mom mumusieriba eng gab ye inorou qent song musiaum.”
Ende qamara Yisas wonou munon qarau eng inorou qent ende ebet igour end Yisas qeemben wurinob qamara igub qininingari munon yamangar ar qei mi qomon uber eng aba gab sig mismisiramirei.
13:18,19 Mit big qob: mastet qur
Yisas qob ger bo qamar: “Qenu wonou bibis big igo eng ye meimit maribig qemerine qeemben buriba?
Eng ete gas, nam mastet qur ger, munon ger ba bis wonou man end goaneterei igama qaut di ir nam aib burerei. Ende ebeterei igama morogan yar nam uben end mon ubet inau big igurei.”
13:20,21 Mit big qob: yis
Ende qamb bo wuri qebi qamar: “Qenu bibis big igo eng meimit maribig qemerine is qeemben buriba?
Eng ete gas, yamangar ger yis baiste ba mani parau aib iset igour eng egit igama ten arirama oab qarib diarei,” qamar.
13:22-30 Tend qomourt end mor isun
Ende qamb wogub ne Yerusalem irib qamb qataben irab ginam aib ne ginam qamaaman end irab-irab qob wuriimbig-imbig ir igoai.
Ende at qib igama munon ger qebi qamar: “Barai, mai Qenu munon gari duor ete wurisiara uberetorubour qiyo?” Ende qamara Yisas taui qamar:
“An Qenu bibis bigor eng isub qamb eng mom qeretut nob wogub mi iru qomourt eng qeemben isuboumon. Munon irou isun qamb obour ego mai gas me isunorei.”

Ende qamb qamar: “Munai ur mor igo mondir mom nausi obotariba. Ende aba ne an is ag igo qeir toau big ne ete nob qomoruboumon, “Barai mondir weimatar.” Ende qamarari wo mor itoi igo ete aninob qemeriba, “ye an qoyam ue, an munon ginam eret yoroumon?”
Ende qamara an taui qomoruboumon, “In erogori, ininou ginamt mi nub igo ne qob inimbig igoan eng diaun.”
Ende nob qamarari wo bo taui aninob qemeriba: An munon qomon soagen abau tari Ye an qoyam ue, qand wogub der iuarimar.”
Ende qamara an is ag igo eab nan suab igo gunon eng, Abraham, Aisak, ne Yekop ne Qenu qob gigit qamarau munon yurau eng, Qenu wonou bibis end igo mismisir igamari ibogouboumon.
Ende abari ne munon worom diat worom isat ne tog qite qumo igour eng di Qenu wonou bibis end qas qiumuni igorubour.
Ende abari munon see ye gigit igoum qemeriner eng bo qanamt igoriba, a “ye qanamt igoum” qemeriner eng bo baraitari gigit igoriba.”
13:31-35 Yisas Yerusalem toubetarei
Ende qamb igama qen end qas Parisi munon qei yar Yisas nob qamamir: “Ne see qas inwogub taut is. Herot nanamb at igo.”

Ende qamarari Yisas taui qamar. “An isub iau qoar boru eng nob ete qamarar, ye see ne barim ende ye ginam qei-qei irab-irab munon ai igaramor eng ne toau asin igab igo eng wurimusub-musub ir igoribam. A barim urigom eng ye sarau mom igeibam,” ende nob qamarar.”

Ende qamb ne bo qamar: “Io, ye see ne barim ue barim urigom eng ye sarau mom ugeibam. Ugab ne Yerusalem weib iribam. End ne Qenu qob gigit qamarau munon eng ginam geret me waramunerei, Yerusalem end qas waramari umiba.”

Ende qamb qamar: “Io, an Yerusalem munon, an qoan Qenu qob gigit qamarau munon eng igaramb ne wonou sarau munon eng anit imurima isari nomont igaramb igumunei isi yarab ne see. Qenen ye aninou munon yurau eng, teteri unor qaman wuriigusub igo gas ende anba qiumunimbine ne ye qarausi igoumon.

End ne Qenu aninou ginam eng mom waga. An ye qand bo me yegunanei. Isi yarab qen geret ete yet qomoruboumon, Munon Baraitari eng Qenu wonou nonogursi musia qeretut nob yara.” ende qomoruboumon.” Ende qamarei.
